objective: Rebuild the closed L000 visual plan from the repaired language and story truth tables. Remove unused transformations and make every negative and OR contrast visually complete.
binding_algorithm: Presentation self-identification uses three full relational scenes in order: scene-taro-ninereeds, scene-emma-bob, scene-taro-errol, plus the current speaker portrait for every modeled turn.
All other presentation gates use scene-taro-ninereeds and the current speaker portrait for each turn.

For every controlled, mixed, reserve, train-longer-resolvable, recap, and direct-application learner-self component, bind the full scene selected by teacher speaker plus portrait-ninereeds and the teacher portrait.
For every negative component, additionally bind the portrait of the identity named after 'Are you' so both the learner and rejected identity operand are visible.
For every OR component, additionally bind the portrait of every named alternative; do not omit Bob from Bob-or-Ninereeds or Taro from Taro-or-Ninereeds.
Pages 01–04 use scene-taro-ninereeds; pages 05–08 use scene-emma-ninereeds. Temporal turn display uses the current speaker portrait without replacing the full scene.
Both narrative comprehension checks use portrait-ninereeds and portrait-emma as the closed options; their worked demonstrations and scored replay retain page/turn evidence bindings.
Every planned master must solve at least one listed learner-facing component. Do not retain an asset merely because it was generated.
crop_policy: literal_crops is empty. These are relational social scenes and contrast option sets; cropping would remove the point rather than clarify it.
pixel_policy: Reuse the already accepted master bytes. Require independent review of every actual displayed asset set after exact assembly; do not claim a parent review proves a future derivative.
